text:
The urinalysis confirms significant hematuria and pyuria, though the negative nitrites suggest a non-bacterial etiology or a non-enteric organism. Given your history of recurrent infections and the presence of clots, have you experienced any episodes of severe flank pain radiating to the groin (renal colic), or have you noticed any blood clots in the urine?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Intravenous_Pyelogram: Multiple cysts present in the collecting ducts of the medulla. No obstruction noted.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease (ADPKD).

The IVP finding of multiple cysts in the collecting ducts, combined with your history of recurrent UTIs, flank pain, and gross hematuria, is diagnostic of ADPKD. I will proceed with no further questions.
